role: source-production reader; final empirical/source claim checking remains separate
anchor_policy: Page plus paragraph/section locator; words in anchors normalize long-s and line breaks; planet/sign names expand visually read glyphs in paraphrase, not as purported verbatim glyph text.
boolean_policy: all/any structure states explicit relations. Where grammar leaves attachment or enumeration unresolved, the uncertainty is retained and no executable single parse is claimed. Branch outputs remain alternatives where the source says or.
genre_policy: Historical horary source audit only. Doctrinal assertions and hypothetical illustrations are not evidence of modern predictive accuracy. Generic experience claims are recorded as unresolved historical anecdotes without invented individual cases.
